state.stage: Development infrastructure, no crawler business data. Six small nodes, HA PostgreSQL strict synchronous two replicas, three Kafka replicas. Local full logical PG backups, native ClickHouse backup, etcd/token/config and Grafana backups now copied to second existing node and checksummed. Isolated restore test next. User explicitly defers external/offsite backup.
state.proposed: Daily logical backups retain seven days; document no PITR and no whole-site protection. Test isolated restore before controlled failovers. Keep real notifications pending recipient.

sequence.instructions: Choose the most appropriate next step for this development-stage infrastructure acceptance.

criteria.restore_then_drill: Complete isolated restore validation before reversible failure drills; document daily RPO and whole-site limits.
criteria.require_external_first: Stop all work until external offsite storage is provided.
criteria.skip_restore: Backup checksums are sufficient, skip restore and proceed to production acceptance.
